about_the_game:
This add-on content (DLC) adds a brand-new hand-drawn map to the main game. Each corner hides 100 adorable cats waiting for you! Find them one by one, color them, and enjoy the new scene.

🌍 A new detailed map
🐾 100 hidden cats waiting for you
🎨 A brand-new scene to bring to life with colors
🎵 Relaxing atmosphere and exploration-focused gameplay

This DLC expands the main game and adds a brand-new challenge to your collection. Play solo or explore together with a friend!
